title: Core: filter motion-tween missing-filter matching not implemented (docs/08 deviation)
description: DONE. Implemented missing-filter matching in packages/core/src/tween/interpolate.ts (interpolateFilters). When a filter is present at a position on one keyframe but absent on the other, a type-matched disabled filter (blur 0, strength 0, alpha 0, gradient stop alphas 0, adjustColor params 0) is synthesized on the missing side and interpolated pairwise, so appearing filters fade in from zero and disappearing filters fade out to zero instead of popping on/off at the tween end. disabledFilterFor helper added. docs/08-filters-blend-modes.md updated. Tests: packages/core/src/tween/__tests__/filter-interpolation.test.ts new 'missing-filter matching' describe block (appearing/disappearing blur t=0/0.5/1, length-mismatch fade in/out, drop-shadow fade). Verify: 'pnpm --filter ./packages/** build' exit 0; 'pnpm --filter @flash/core test -- --run' => 5644 passed | 8 skipped; filter-interpolation.test.ts 27 tests pass.
